name: dax_minx_over_a_constructor_skips_blanks

measures.name: Lowest Average
measures.formula:
VAR sold = AVERAGE(Sales[units_sold])
VAR received = AVERAGE(Sales[units_received])
RETURN MINX({sold, received}, [Value])

expect_sql:
SELECT LEAST(COALESCE((AVG(t.units_sold)), (AVG(t.units_received))), COALESCE((AVG(t.units_received)), (AVG(t.units_sold)))) AS lowest_average
FROM   retail.fct_sales t
